_comment: What claude-code.json must produce from claude-code.fixture.jsonl. This is the red test that makes 'repair this connector' a closed task: an agent has the declaration, a sample, and a way to know it is done. The fixture ends on a deliberately truncated line — a transcript is appended to while it is read, and the parser must drop that fragment rather than treat it as format drift.
_artifacts: Two files, from the two kinds of evidence. a.ts was recorded by a Write tool call (origin 'tool'); draft.md was read out of a redirection in a Bash command (origin 'shell'). Measured 2026-08-29: 98 of 211 real sessions wrote files the second way and no other, so a fixture that only exercised the first would prove the wrong thing. Newest first, because the walk runs backwards.
